purchase.direct_needs_approval: Without a purchase order the receipt is a direct purchase, and only someone who can approve purchases (Admin) can post it.
purchase.grn_line_not_on_order: Every line of the receipt must be a line of the chosen order.
purchase.grn_missing: That goods receipt is not in this company.
purchase.grn_wrong_supplier: The goods are from another supplier than the order.
purchase.order_missing: That purchase order is not in this company.
purchase.order_state: The order is not in a state that allows this.
purchase.over_limit: This request is above your approval limit, so it goes to Admin.
purchase.over_receipt: More is received than was ordered. Receive only what the order allows.
purchase.price_increase: Some lines are dearer than the last purchase. Check them, tick “I accept the price increase”, then issue again.
purchase.request_locked: Only a draft request can be changed.
purchase.request_not_approved: The request must be approved before asking suppliers for quotes.
purchase.request_not_yours: Only the person who made the request can change it.
purchase.request_state: Only a request sent for approval can be decided.
purchase.rfq_closed: This request for quotation is closed: a quotation has already been chosen.
purchase.rfq_line_missing: That line is not on this request for quotation.
purchase.rfq_missing: That request for quotation was not found.

capture.locked: This bill photo is already used for a bill.
capture.missing: That bill photo was not found.
capture.needs_admin: The bill does not match the order and the goods received. Only Admin can turn it into a bill.
capture.photo: Take or upload the photo first.
capture.photo_path: The photo must be stored under this company’s folder.
capture.state: Do the earlier step first: type the fields, then match, then make the bill.

sod.own_request: You made this request, so you cannot approve it. Another approver must decide it.
sod.own_order: You drafted this order, so you cannot issue it. Another approver must issue it.
sod.own_count: Someone who did not count must approve the differences.
sod.tester_receiver: The person who received the goods cannot test them.
sod.releaser_receiver: The person who received the goods cannot release them.
sod.not_picker: Only the person who picked confirms the handover.
sod.picker_carrier: The carrier confirms on their own login, not the picker.
sod.picker_receiver: The picker cannot receive the same transfer.
sod.picker_close: The picker or carrier cannot close the transfer.
sod.witness_required: A second authorised person must witness this receipt.
sod.write_off: A shortage is never written off by the picker, the carrier or the receiver.

msme.terms_over_45: An MSME supplier must be paid within 45 days at most (MSMED Act, section 15). Shorten the payment terms.

stock.place_other_company: Choose a store of this company.
stock.qty: Every line needs a quantity above zero.
stock.insufficient: There is not enough stock for this.
stock.lot_mismatch: That lot is not of this item and company.

qc.not_in_quarantine: This lot is not waiting for a test.

doc.qty: Every line needs a quantity above zero.
doc.rate: Enter the quoted rate for every line.
doc.discount: A discount cannot be more than the line value.

org.gstin_other_company: Choose a GSTIN of this company.

date.future: The date cannot be in the future.

period.no_fy: No financial year is open for this date. Admin opens it on Numbering & IDs.
period.closed: That month is closed. Ask Admin.
